items.title: 3 US AI Infrastructure Stocks Facing The 5% Treasury Yield Test
items.summary: AI infrastructure spending is colliding with a jump in the US 10-year yield toward 5%, and that mix is shaking up how investors think about capital-heavy stories. Higher discount rates and pricier debt are forcing a sharper test of which projects might justify their cost. This article walks through three stocks exposed to that theme and shows how each could be positioned as rates, politics and AI ambitions pull in different directions. items.title: Bernstein names stocks to buy as data centre political risks appear overstated
